test: out-of-sample evaluation of the LOCKED cross-shape predictor
oos_family: Xiao 2020 29-case periodic-hill DNS (Re_b=5600), amplitude x pitch
interpretation: All 29 brand-new O(delta)-pitch repeating hills MEASURE catastrophic (R2<0, max=-9.86) -> the binary failure thesis is confirmed 29/29 out of sample.  The LOCKED coverage gate (COV_STAR=0.30, frozen on a MIXED corpus) recovers 16/29 of them (recall=0.55): it under-fires at the mild end because within an ALL-failure family the across-class threshold is conservative.  Within the family, SEVERITY (how negative R2 is) is best ordered by L_sep/delta (rho=-0.75), the O(delta) separation length -- the physical realisation of 'pitch ~ O(delta)' -- and coverage tracks L_sep/delta (rho=0.65).  The single-feature controls (incl. BFS at the zero-frequency limit) tolerate up to coverage=0.200; it is REPEATING-class membership, not a single coverage number, that triggers domain-wide cancellation.
